lines.text: A supply boat has reached the quay. Damaged access leaves its workers stranded.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: The landing can wait. Get them onto dry ground.

lines.speaker: Landing clerk
lines.text: This cargo was signed in yesterday.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: Then yesterday can lend us a hand.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Hold the approach, mend the access, or help move the injured. Tell me where you need me.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Every worker is accounted for. Now we can ask why two orders claim the same cargo.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: The chest and fittings are secure. We will put your chosen priority to work first.

variants.medical: The dry medical chest comes first. The pump crate will wait in salvage holding.
variants.pump: The pump fittings come first. The care station will draw on its emergency reserve.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: The seals agree. The cargo and the witnesses do not.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Keep the independent account. A claim on paper cannot make one fitting serve two works.

lines.speaker: Serit Voss
lines.text: Keep the crew clear. I can hold the bypass.
Voss stays at the work while the crew withdraws. The salvaged equipment can now be installed.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Our crew will hold the bypass while we take the reading.

variants.medical: Your medical chest is ready. We will hold a crew-operated bypass until the fittings are recovered.
variants.pump: Your pump fittings are ready. The care station has used its reserve; the test mechanism can now work properly.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Try the marked gauge yourself. Then decide who should see the account.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: We have a reading, witnesses, and your decision. That is an account worth keeping.
The first emergency is over. Your work and chosen account have been recorded.
At the private test work, a stranded crew waits beyond a bypass that will not stay open.

lines.speaker: Serit Voss
lines.text: Leave the part alone. Brace this bypass and get the crew clear first.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: I will show the controls. You can hold the approach or help the work. Keep a safe way back.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Check the bypass, secure its brace, then release the crew. We fit the salvaged equipment after everyone is safe.

lines.speaker: Serit Voss
lines.text: The brace is holding. Go now; I am staying here until you are clear.

lines.speaker: Works Hand
lines.text: Across and safe. Nobody left behind.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Now we can install the salvaged part and make an honest test.

variants.medical: Your medical reserve is ready. The crew will operate a braced bypass while we test the work.
variants.pump: The pump fitting you saved can now be installed. The care station has spent its reserve.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: The intake and diversion do different jobs. Watch the water, then compare the independent gauge.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: The stream tells you what the controls are doing. The gauge supplies an independent comparison.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: A mark in the permitted column is a claim. A reading you can reproduce is evidence.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Record the result you observed. Then decide how this account should be shared.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: The crew is safe and the test can be repeated. Your chosen account stays with the evidence.

lines.speaker: Serit Voss
lines.text: Then put down what happened here, including what it cost.
Party members choose individually whether to record this outcome. Helping another expedition does not overwrite your own story.
